title: Lumen Lattice
archiveRole: First Puzzle Logic Hall observation sample
description: A constraint logic puzzle where pressing a node flips its whole row and column. Every lattice is generated by scrambling a solved board, so it is guaranteed solvable.

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. The game, its puzzle generator, and its solving-aware hint system were written by Claude Code under the no-human-code-edits project rule. The launcher was also updated by the same agent in this entry; only this new game's source was authored, no other AI-made game was modified.

keyboard: WASD or Arrow keys to move the cursor
Space or Enter to fire a node
pointer: Click a node to fire its row and column
touch: Tap a node to fire its row and column
